blocks.prompt: 8 (i)(a) How many (a) diagonals and (b) triangles can be formed by joining the vertices of the polygon having: (i) 5 sides? Part (a): diagonals.
blocks.explanation:
Pentagon ke 5 vertices (kone) hain. Kisi bhi do vertices ko jorein to ek line segment banta hai; yeh segment ya to side hota hai ya diagonal.
Find kya karna hai? Diagonals ki tadaad.
Plan: pehle saare jore \({}^{5}C_{2}\) ginein, phir 5 sides minus kar dein. Yaad rakhein: diagonal woh line hai jo do aise vertices ko jore jo saath saath (parosi) na hon.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 5 sides wala polygon, yani 5 vertices (koi teen ek seedh mein nahi).
Humein find karna hai: diagonals.
Tareeqa: Line segment do end points se ban jata hai, aur AB aur BA ek hi line hai, is liye yeh 2 vertices ka combination hai. Lekin is ginti mein polygon ki sides bhi shamil hain, unhein nikalna parega.

Saare segments ginein
\[{}^{5}C_{2} = \dfrac{5 \cdot 4}{2} = 10\]
Kyun: Har do vertices ka jora theek ek segment deta hai, aur AB aur BA ek hi segment hain, is liye permutation nahi balke combination lagaya.

Sides minus karein
\[10 - 5 = 5\]
Kyun: In segments mein se 5 to polygon ki apni sides hain (saath wale vertices ko jorne wali). Diagonal sirf woh hai jo aamne saamne ya door ke vertices ko jore.
Dhyan dein: Sides minus karna bhool jana is sawal ki sab se aam ghalti hai.

Tasdeeq: formula se
\[\dfrac{n(n-3)}{2} = \dfrac{5 \times 2}{2}\]
\[= 5 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Har vertex se diagonal sirf \(n - 3\) vertices tak jata hai (khud aur do parosi vertices ko chhor kar). Har diagonal dono siron se do dafa gina jata hai, is liye 2 se divide kiya.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal har polygon ke liye (a) diagonals aur (b) triangles poochta hai, yani 6 jawab. Answer key sirf 3 deti hai: i) 10, ii) 20, iii) 54. 20 aur 54 to 8 aur 12 sides wale polygons ke diagonals hain, lekin pentagon ke diagonals 5 hain, 10 nahi (10 us ke triangles hain). Sahi jawab: diagonals 5, 20, 54; triangles 10, 56, 220.

blocks.prompt: 8 (i)(b) How many (a) diagonals and (b) triangles can be formed by joining the vertices of the polygon having: (i) 5 sides? Part (b): triangles.
blocks.explanation:
Pentagon ke koi bhi 3 vertices (koi teen ek seedh mein nahi) ek triangle banate hain.
Find kya karna hai? Triangles ki tadaad.
Plan: \({}^{5}C_{3}\). Yahan koi cheez minus nahi karni, kyunke har teen kone hamesha ek triangle banate hain.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 5 vertices.
Humein find karna hai: in points par kone rakhne wale triangles.
Tareeqa: Triangle apne teen konon se pehchana jata hai. ABC, BCA, CAB sab ek hi triangle hain, yani tarteeb se farq nahi parta. Is liye 3 vertices ka combination.

3 vertices chunein
\[{}^{5}C_{3} = \dfrac{5 \cdot 4 \cdot 3}{6} = 10\]
Kyun: 5 se neeche teen numbers multiply kiye aur \(3! = 6\) se divide kiya.
Dhyan dein: Yahan sides minus nahi karni; har teen vertices ka group zaroor ek triangle banata hai.

Tasdeeq
\[{}^{5}P_{3} \div 3! = 60 \div 6 = 10 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Tarteeb wale triples har triangle ko \(3! = 6\) dafa ginte hain (ABC, ACB, BAC, BCA, CAB, CBA), is liye 6 se divide karne par asal ginti milti hai. Doosre raste se bhi wahi jawab aana is baat ka saboot hai ke hisaab sahi hai.
